recensioni.testo:
Beautiful hotel, great location across from Central Park. Hotel was nicely renovated from the original St. Moritz.
Guest rooms are luxurious and spotlessly maintained by the housekeepers.
The lobby and guest floors were nicely decorated for the Christmas season. Reception and concierge staff are welcoming and attentive.
The General Manager, Hans Schaepman was very accommodating and understanding when notified of a problem we encountered.

We stayed at the Ritz for a week in one of the club suites. The room had two bathrooms, a living area, and a quiet bedroom. Being at Central Park, you couldn't ask for a better location. The club provided us with excellent meals and drinks. When we had to go several blocks, the hotel offered its house Mercedes to us. The housekeeping was wonderful, the front desk helped us with whatever we needed, and it was an all-around great experience. If you are able to, it's worth a stay.

We had a great weekend trip in NYC. Room was great, but a little hot. Overall though great trip and the hotel is only a block away from 5th Avenue. Had great room serivce and the staff was very attentive. Thank you for a great trip to NYC at Christmas.

One of the worst Ritz Carlton hotel we have stayed. Hotel room interiors are outdated, service is lacking, room service food is bad and front desk were unwelcoming. Its saving grace is the location to Central Park and shopping belt. That's about it. For the price it is charging, we can find much better hotels else.

I’m staying here right now. Please be aware that if you don’t book a room with a view your room will feel like a cave. We have two windows and the blind on one window is actually broken. There’s no tea or coffee making facilities, no cups and nowhere to put anything of your own in a fridge. I dread to think what it would be like if you needed to store baby milk. The price of basic food for room service and breakfast is bordering on robbery. 
Beds are comfy and the location is great. This is supposed to be a luxury hotel but it really doesn’t feel like it in this room.

Beautiful hotel and ideal location! Very expensive with no included amenities. Breakfast for two $150! Coffee cart available 6-8 am! Really! As an avid traveler, I will stay elsewhere in future. Paying for name only.

Its saving grace is the location to Central Park and shopping belt. That's about it. For the price it is charging, we can find much better hotels else.

Travel to NYC a lot and often stay at the JW Marriott because we love it there. We thought we would splurge and stay at the Ritz Carlton Central Park this time, bad decision. The room was nice and the doormen are fantastic but that’s about it. The lobby is small and not very inviting, and restaurant not very enjoyable. But the real issue is the front desk staff and manager. They were so rude to us, it almost ruined our entire vacation. You hear about the incredible service that these people are supposed to give it to you, but it was just horrifying and we will never be back.

Poor services, tired rooms, basic amenities missing. Called concierge to deliver suitcase to the room. After 30 minutes I had to retrieve it. Room had rope for one one guest even though booked for 2. No free water offered. Room decor feels tired.
